open_checks: PGEN range starts 2020-02-05 though the symbol changed effective 2020-02-03 (minor)
verdict: Same security renamed Intrexon to Precigen (XON to PGEN, 2020-02-03) after a 2018 NYSE-to-Nasdaq move; no ending, so the new run's removal of the transfer row is right.

fields_refuted.why: 8-K 0001193125-20-023400 shows the symbol change took effect at the open of 2020-02-03, so XON's last session was 2020-01-31. The old XON end (2020-01-31) is correct. The new XON end (2020-02-04) comes from fails rows lagging by settlement and is wrong. PGEN's start (2020-02-05) is late in both runs. The new run removes the gap but is less accurate, so neither side is right and 'new' is not supported.

verification.notes: Removal of the 2020 exchange row is right: this was a rename, and the only Form 25 is the 2018 NYSE to Nasdaq move. The FIGI rename of the placeholder is expected. I appended section 9 and a verification object to the report and the record json.
